name: consultation
description: Product consultation: explore what outcome to pursue and why, then pause for owner discussion without implementation. When the owner chooses an outcome and asks to proceed, the task manager appends a manual plan stage to this same task rather than starting a replacement one.

stages.name: consultation
stages.description: Consultant evaluates alternatives, evidence, tradeoffs, assumptions, and unknowns, records a recommendation, and remains at the manual owner discussion gate; delivery stages are appended to this task only on the owner's explicit instruction
